column3: MT 47:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “strike the palm” is rendered “clap your hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; גְּאוֹן (“the pride”) is rendered “The excellence.”
Close to the Hebrew; שׁוֹפָר (“the ram’s horn”) is rendered “a trumpet.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַשְׂכִּיל (“a maskil”) is rendered “with understanding.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the nobles of the peoples” is rendered “The princes of the people.”
